description: Specify the number of zones on an edge. The value of i must be positive (up to 1000 ). The default value is 3 . When zones are generated from the building blocks set, all blocks attached to an edge in < range > will have i zones along the direction defined by the edge. If < range > is not supplied all edges are affected.
notes: Requires a current building-blocks set: run 'building-blocks set create <name>' then 'building-blocks set select <name>' before any block/edge/face/point operation; otherwise FLAC rejects the command with 'Unused extra parameter'.

7.0.description: Specify the number of zones on an edge. The value of i must be positive (up to 1000 ). The default value is 3 . When zones are generated from the building blocks set, all blocks attached to an edge in < range > will have i zones along the direction defined by the edge. If < range > is not supplied all edges are affected. Each time the size on an edge is changed, the changes are propagated to face-connected opposite edges.
